title: LF people who can draw Pokemon
content:
LF people who can draw Pokemon

You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario.

I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style ,, place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS!

This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes (similar to Emma from Veil) so please be able to draw those too!

MOP: GCash, like always

title: HIRING Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist
content:
HIRING!

Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist
Fully Remote
https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm

Role Overview

We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity.
This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.

What You’ll Do
1. Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images.
2. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency.
3. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion.
4. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes based on project requirements.
5. Document creative decisions, style choices, and simple prompt metadata.
6. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.

Contact via the Turing link.
